summary: Every requirement of issue #1034 and the frozen AC (FR-01.03 AC24) is implemented as written, GPT-leg-only scope: opt-in ordered gpt_leg.routes list (closed set codex/openrouter/direct, malformed degrades to the provider path); moves to the next route both before the call (unavailable -> skipped) and at runtime (error, degraded, raised exception); every skipped or failed route recorded in attempts with a bounded reason, fallback_reason kept; existing provider configs unchanged and pinned by a test; opus and GLM legs untouched. Extra edits to check-external-review-keys.py (codex_configured also true for a routes list naming codex) and docs are in scope.
